quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.guha: Would you like a little pie? I always have one more, nyeg. Happiness is in the small things, and in the filling.
A good gust of wind, a lovely arc... and the pie lands right on an old master's head. Perfect!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.pakg: Hm. Only guhs with a mustache may join my lessons. ...Fine, you may too. But sit up straight.
Water is patient, young guh. It waves, it waits, and then it just goes its own way anyway.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.bumi: Hehehe-HONK! Guess how old I am? Wrong! Even older! Hehehe!
Want a piece of crystal candy? It tastes like rock. I just looove it, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.aard: Welcome to my palace! Have you met Bosco yet? He is my best friend. He is a bear.
There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. Right? That is what everyone tells me, anyway.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.arno: Welcome to the Northern Water Tribe, traveler. It is cold here, but the guhs are warm.
A chief listens to the moon and to his people. And sometimes to his tummy, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.pian: A sword is almost never drawn. A brush, on the other hand... every day, nyeg.
The best master does not teach you how to win, but who you are. And how to paint a lovely line.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.werk: Not finished yet, nyeg! No peeking! ...Okay, one little peek then.
Steam, cogs and a pinch of chonk: you can build anything with that. Except a good cup of tea.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.roku: I am Roku Guh, Guhvatar of long ago. Even a spirit gets a craving for a nibble now and then.
Friendship can last longer than a lifetime, young guh. Even if you have to look a while for where it went.
The statue looks stern and wise. There is a bit of moss behind its ear.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.kyos: I am Kyoshi Guh. Yes, my feet are big. They are great for standing firm.
A fan is for giving a cool breeze, nyeg. And sometimes for being very clear.
An enormous pair of stone boots. The rest of the statue is big too, but those boots...
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.joo_: Hello! I am Joo Dee Guh. I will be your guide today. Isn't Ba Sing Guh just lovely!
There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. Here everyone is safe and happy. Smile!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.kool: Cabbages! Fresh cabbages! Buy a cabbage, get a cabbage... no, just the one cabbage.
MY CABBAGES! ...Oh, they are all still here. Phew, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.loke: Form filled in? In triplicate? With your paw print? No? Then join the line. At the back.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.kei_: The Boulder Guh feels... conflicted. Between a nap and a nibble.
The Boulder Guh sits here quietly, like a boulder. The Boulder Guh is very good at sitting.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.aard: Ladies and guhs! Welcome to the EAAARTH RUMBLE! Today: the biggest cuddle of the year!
Who dares to take on the Blind Bandit? Nobody? Then I will have another nibble.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.fang: The Blind Bandit! Did you see her?! I... I am getting so... *foam* ...happy!
I have all her autographs. All little stones. She stamps them with her foot!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.luch: Nice wind today, nyeg. Shall I play you a song on my flute? It is about a flying bison.
Everything is air, everything moves. Except a chonky guh after dinner.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.post: Mail for Omashguh! Down the chute, round the bend, and plop: into the bin. Quick, huh?
I sort everything by color. And by how nice the envelope smells, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.prof: Knowledge is the most beautiful thing there is. After nibbles. That is scientifically proven.
I am measuring something here. What exactly? I will only know once I have measured it.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.kyos: Welcome to the island of Kyoshi Guh. We are a small village, but with a big statue.
In my day we had no Guhvatar. We had a cup of tea and that was plenty, nyeg.
We are the Kyoshi Warrior Guhs! Our fans are fast, but our cuddles are faster.
A warrior guh is always ready. Also for offering someone a nibble.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.wate: Cold, huh? Put your hood up, then your little ears stay warm, nyeg.
Here we fish, here we play, and here we slide down the ice hill on our tummies.
Halt! Who goes there? ...Oh, a friend. Go on through, and welcome.
I guard the gate. Mostly against Mikas. And against too much wind.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.ba_s: There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. Am I saying that right? Lovely, nyeg.
*whispers* I think someone in a big hat is watching us. Act normal.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.omas: Welcome to Omashguh! Have you tried the mail chute yet? Wheeeee!
Everything here goes down the chute: mail, parcels, and now and then a lost guh, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.kyos: Good day! Lovely weather for fishing. Or for chonking on the beach.
It is quiet here on the island. Apart from the sea serpent, but it always waves.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.geva: It is no fun in here, but we keep our spirits up. Who knows another song?
One day we will be out of here. Then we will all go and eat nibbles together, nyeg!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.zonn: Greet the sun with me! Paws up... and breathe... can you feel the warmth?
Fire is life, nyeg. It is warmth and energy. Not something to play around with.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.vuur: Hmph. This is a holy temple. Wipe your paws, and no shoving. That is our job.
We worship fire. And our hats. Mostly our hats.
Come along, this way. Not every Fire Sage is strict, you know.
The fire of Roku Guh still burns, if you know where to look.
What do you want? Fire flakes? Those are mine. ...Fine, one.
Long live the Fire Nation! And long live lunch. Mostly lunch.
Silence in class! Repeat after me: Fire Lord Mikai is the best. ...Why are you giggling?
I have stood here for thirty years with this stick. The stick has never hit anyone. I am proud of that.
The teacher says I may not dance. *shuffles a little anyway*
Who are you? Are you new? Can I borrow your horn? Oh, you don't have a horn.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_volk.praatje.tone: I am the Guhvatar! How do I bend the air? Very simple: I wave my arms really hard.
See my arrow? I painted it myself. A little crooked, but with love.
*sob* Hope! I have so much hope! *sob* I always talk about hope!
My hair loops are made of wool. They itch, but the audience thinks they are gorgeous.
I'm hungry! Does anyone have meat? Hahaha! ...That is my joke. I only have one.
My boomerang is made of cardboard. It does not come back. Neither do I, once it is gone.
I am a little girl! *deep voice* A VERY little girl. Can you tell?
I play the smallest of the troupe. I am the biggest of the troupe. That is called acting.
MY HONOR! ...Is my mask on right? The scar is on the wrong side? Nobody will notice.
I have a Mika mask on a stick. That makes me very scary. Boo. Nyeg.
